round_de_table_cols <- c(

msigdb_dir <- "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"

# Clinical variables

## Extracting and transforming

```{r}
meta_clinic <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_wv1to4_clinical.csv")) %>%
  as.data.frame()
meta_sample <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_waves1to4_sample_mapping.csv")) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
meta_subtypes <- meta_clinic[,c("dbgap_rnaseq_sample", "consensusAMLFusions", "ELN2017",
              "FLT3-ITD", "priorMDS", "priorMDSMPN", "fabBlastMorphology", "priorMPN")]
meta_subtypes$fabBlastMorphology[meta_subtypes$fabBlastMorphology %in% c("M0", "M6", "M0/M1", "M6a", "M6b")] <-  'M0_6'
meta_subtypes$fabBlastMorphology[meta_subtypes$fabBlastMorphology %in% c("M5", "M5a", "M5b")] <-  'M5_merged'

cat("Overview of clinical variables:\n")
sapply(meta_subtypes[,-1], table)
htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(data.frame(meta_subtypes),
                                 filter = "top",
                                 extensions = "Buttons",
                               options = list(
                                 dom = "Bfrtip",
                                 buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
                                 autoWidth = TRUE
                               )))
```

```{r}
merge_meta <- function(dge_obj, meta_subtypes) {
  idx <- match(rownames(dge_obj$samples), meta_subtypes$dbgap_rnaseq_sample)
  cols_to_add <- setdiff(colnames(meta_subtypes), "dbgap_rnaseq_sample")
  dge_obj$samples[cols_to_add] <- meta_subtypes[idx, cols_to_add]
  dge_obj
}

dge      <- merge_meta(dge,      meta_subtypes)
dge_norm <- merge_meta(dge_norm, meta_subtypes)
dge_cat  <- merge_meta(dge_cat,  meta_subtypes)
```
